div.div:
Purple — dense core: used for every generated token; exported in int4 groups and staged as int8 in PSRAM.
Blue — sparse tables: one row lookup per token; stored in flash.
Yellow — stream: full output head scan per generated token. The V2 head is tied to the token embedding.

text.tspan: Purple — dense core: used for every generated token; exported in int4 groups and staged as int8 in PSRAM.
Blue — sparse tables: one row lookup per token; stored in flash.
Yellow — stream: full output head scan per generated token. The V2 head is tied to the token embedding.
